# laya-go farm prompt v1 golden request

`request.json` is laya-go's `games/farm/prompt/testdata/v1_sample_request.json` (laya-go commit `0f2a55f`, branch `farm`). The farm: a wheat plot north-west of the bot around a pool (two ripe, one empty cell), carrots to the east, a path, a fence to the south; ground within 4 blocks of the pool is G, beyond it L.
